description: Meta keeps its container images and its GitHub Actions under Renovate, pinned like Core's: the release build container and the Bazel platform images by digest, every action by commit SHA.

customManagers.description: Container images pinned by digest where no built-in manager reads them: the release workflow's build container expression and the Bazel execution platforms.

packageRules.description: The build container builds every Linux release binary and the platform images run remote builds: a new digest is proposed a week after its release, in a group of its own, and never automerged.

A digest update of a pinned action (its tag now names another commit) waits for approval on the dependency dashboard: minimumReleaseAge holds back new versions only, and a moved tag keeps its original date.

GitHub Actions run with the workflow token, OIDC and release secrets: pinned to commit SHAs (helpers:pinGitHubActionDigests; the CI workflow tests check these rules), new versions proposed a week after their release, in a group of their own, and never automerged. Keep this rule last.
